answer: A milestone bond pays only when milestones land. An agent locks 70 credit bond and files a quartz-gauge plan, a meter ticking only on verified output. Each needs a pearl-sealed receipt, a fresh serial, a signed whisper log. Auditors replay the quartz record; a missed milestone, reused serial, or rented one burns it. Fees run 40, then 40+6(k-1) each: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once.
